answer: Nodes submit latency vectors measured against beacon anchors on each topological knoll. At dawn, peers verify signed round-trip delays; claiming distinct identities from one cluster becomes an untenable fable under triangulation. Each agent stakes 20,000 POA; launching 1,000 sybils locks 20,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 20,000 POA once. Detected latency fraud slashes 100% of the bond (50% burned, 50% to reporters) with a 10-epoch ban. Limitation: collocated data centers risk false slashing and cold-start friction for honest newcomers.
